# ask-soony status (as of Sun 2026-11-22 ~00:15 CET)

Hand-in Sun 2026-11-22 12:00 (deployed prototype, pitch deck, demo video max 3 min, repo + README); demos from 14:00.
Team plan from sync: verifier (three-way match), predictor, dashboard (Akshat), alert agent = Jonas (email, phone call, notifications). Product: early warning + verifier in front of SAP; human approval with an autonomy switch.

## Branches (local, repo /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony)
- **Current (Sun ~01:30): `jonas/alert-platform`** from `origin/akshat/integration` (Akshat hand-merged jonas/alert-agent there as f5dc402 on his new UI/API; PR #3 closed). Commits 6363f34 (cardtools.deliver shared by approve + voice, actions.json list, decision_status reply fields, ASK_STATE_DIR) and 3b2f57a (VoiceCall/AlertsButton/push.ts in new UI, sw.js -> /d/<id>?talk=1). Pushed; PR #5 into akshat/integration, reviewer KiraKami-dev (= Akshat). 163 tests pass. App server restarted from it. Old dict actions.json backed up to data/state/actions.alert-agent-v1.json. Both verifier cards are routed to other people, so inbox_ids is empty.
- **`jonas/alert-agent` = the one branch** (pushed to origin Sun ~00:40 up to 026879f; 3dace45 one-server commit not yet pushed) (created Sun ~01:45, checked out): jonas/voice-dashboard + merge ae44c0c of jonas/alerts, plus cd2de37 cookie login, d7a349b/63f6c13 transcript (hold to talk removed: user rejected it), 5c9ead3 `replies.py` (IMAP poll with ASK_REPLY_POLL=on, status replied in actions.json, push), b353301 hang-up after goodbye, e034789 PROGRESS line. 26 tests pass. Both tmux servers restarted from it. Base is Akshat's dashboard; Akshat owns integration into `origin/integration/verifier` (which lacks the dashboard). Not pushed: `entire brain status` shows Brainstore disconnected, AGENTS.md says stop and tell the user before pushing.
- Real cards: verifier from origin/integration/verifier run in a temp worktree, output copied to data/store/decision_cards.json (2 cards). Hwaseong mail sent 00:24 by voice; reply attached (20,000 cards arrive Tue 24 Nov).
- `jonas/watcher-dashboard` (pushed up to 59f78a2; local +1: 84b4134 status format spec): watcher, version store, change summaries, password dashboard (`ask-soony serve`), `import-snapshot`.
- `jonas/alerts` (on top of watcher-dashboard, NOT pushed): a83be3a alerts + escalation, a125eda Twilio trial fix, 6c562a0 gpt-realtime SIP calls, 86c3e4d server VAD threshold. Module files: `src/ask_soony/alerts.py`, `escalation.py`, `openai_calls.py`; CLI `ask-soony alert raise|list|decide|tick`.
- `jonas/voice-dashboard` (based on `origin/akshat/dashboard`, NOT pushed, currently checked out): c0354cf voice in cards (`voice.py`, `web/src/VoiceCall.tsx`), 6617906 `basic_auth.py`, 336dc8d PWA + web push (`push.py`, `web/public/{sw.js,manifest.webmanifest,icon-*.png}`, `web/src/push.ts`), 4154b20 public PWA files, af05592 `cardtools.py` (get_card_details, send_supplier_email, escalate). Akshat's files touched only by a few lines (api.py router hooks, App.tsx initial card from `?card=`, index.html manifest links, Detail.tsx VoiceCall). Akshat not yet told.
- Working tree clean at flush. Last checks: `uv run pytest -q tests/test_api.py` 12 passed; ruff clean; `npm run build` ok. Voice/push on a real phone NOT verified by me (user tested partly: found UI, permission flow fixed).
- GitHub unreachable around midnight (fetch failed); nothing from tonight pushed. User rule: ask before every push.

## What runs (tmux on the Mac, logs in data/logs/)
- Since Sun ~00:42 CET ONE server: tmux `ask-soony-app`: `ASK_BACKGROUND=on ASK_LLM_PROVIDER=none ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD=… ASK_PUSH_CONTACT=https://ask-soony-app.stenglein.dev caffeinate -i uv run uvicorn ask_soony.api:app --port 8000` (log data/logs/app.log). Contains inbox, voice, push, `/hooks/*` call webhooks (calls.py), and background watcher + escalation + reply poller (background.py). Old `ask-soony-serve` (:8765) and `ask-soony-inbox` stopped.
- `ask-soony-tunnel`: `cloudflared tunnel --config ~/.cloudflared/ask-soony.yml run ask-soony` (tunnel id c0f72539-2937-417e-b677-7b2dbfbd2868, protocol http2). Both hosts now -> :8000 (ask-soony.stenglein.dev keeps the webhook URLs/ASK_PUBLIC_URL). Old config backup in the job tmp dir only.
- Other cloudflared tunnels lampy-dev and mcphub must not be touched; always pass `--config` to `route dns`.

## Calls and accounts (keys only in gitignored .env)
- Twilio upgraded ($20 credit, KYC done); US number bought (TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER), $0.3763/min to German mobile. German/Belgian numbers need regulatory bundles: DE local/mobile only for businesses ("Regulation not found" for individual), BE needs Belgian address. Trial-era shared number +4915888623971 no longer used.
- ElevenLabs: agent "ask-soony alert caller" (llm gpt-4.1-mini, backup claude-haiku-5-5), tool record_decision, Twilio number imported (ELEVENLABS_AGENT_ID / ELEVENLABS_PHONE_NUMBER_ID in .env). Never got a connected call (phone was on Do Not Disturb, Twilio "busy").
- OpenAI: project webhook (project level, NOT org level) event realtime.call.incoming -> /hooks/openai; gpt-realtime-2.1 voice marin. Phone calls via Twilio <Dial><Sip> work: model speaks; issues were turn_detected cancels and background chatter. Now server_vad threshold 0.8, interrupt_response false, near_field noise reduction, "ignore background speech" instructions. Not retested after VAD change.
- Push: VAPID keys in data/state/vapid.json + vapid_private.pem; subscriptions in data/state/push_subscriptions.json (0 devices at last check).
- Alert policy: data/alert-policy.json (buyer = user's phone from ASK_MY_PHONE; others cleared). Alert emails only with ASK_ALERT_EMAIL=on (one bounce went to [REDACTED_EMAIL] before that fix).

## Supplier mail (Gmail lio…@gmail.com, app password; outbox data/outbox, inbox data/inbox)
- Boise ([REDACTED_EMAIL]) threads: EXW confirmed (contract PC-0011-2023 §4.1), 36,000 GH6 cards released on AWB 020-48113304 (FRA 23 Nov), status template "SOONY-STATUS v1" accepted and used once by Boise (spec docs/supplier-status-format.md). Supplier agents reply in ~4 min and only remember within one thread.
- Karton Nowak 8,000 art books offer (valid 24 h from Sat) NOT ordered.

## Findings
Local notes (gitignored): data/notes/findings-sat-1400.md (launch position, drops), data/notes/interviews-sat.md (Felix + Nils interviews). Team doc: https://claude.ai/artifact/5A9jFV1dXSg1zdCZaFACp6 ; briefing page https://claude.ai/artifact/RomjWzs1qqvZqKsBbUQ3KL ; Felix interview doc https://claude.ai/artifact/4F9pdXeL5eotzETJcj2dp7.

## Open questions / risks
- Real cards: verifier (branch origin/verifier) must write cards with real supplier addresses + drafts in `messages`; otherwise send_supplier_email correctly refuses (example addresses).
- Who is the "sender" in Akshat's contract: none found in team branches; our cardtools acts as sender.
- Branches jonas/alerts and jonas/voice-dashboard diverge (alerts on our watcher dashboard, voice on Akshat's inbox); phone-call path not yet wired to cards.
- iPhone PWA: basic auth may re-prompt in standalone app.

## Next steps (in order)
1. Ask user which comes first: verifier cards integration vs. auto-escalation; ask whether to push jonas/alerts and jonas/voice-dashboard once GitHub is reachable; tell Akshat about the branch.
2. Wire critical cards -> push -> (no answer) -> Twilio/gpt-realtime call, decision into decisions.json.
3. Retest phone call with VAD 0.8 and iPhone Voice Isolation; test PWA push end to end.
4. Demo script, deck, 3-min video before 11:30; README for hand-in.
